email.subject: Zarqa SCADA: independent design team check
email.initial:
Hi Osaid,

A reported Zarqa SCADA design-and-tender-assistance opportunity may merit a dialogue between MENA-Water’s instrumentation team and Aqualine’s Jordan engineering team. The idea would be local process knowledge plus vendor-neutral controls design.

The official EOI has not yet been verified. This appears to be a consultancy lead, and independent design qualifications and supplier conflicts must be checked before proposing a team.

Who would be best placed to assess the consultancy scope and independent-design credentials? If there is a fit, I’d ask both sides before arranging an introduction with Khalaf Dannoon. Neither side has committed.

If this is outside your remit, a referral would help. If you would prefer no further emails, please let me know.
followups:
Hi Osaid,

Following up on Zarqa SCADA design advisory lead. The first question is whether MENA-Water would add a distinct, necessary work package. For your side, I had in mind: candidate Jordan site/process engineering and local coordination.

Is that a useful scope to explore, or should I speak with another owner?

Hi Osaid,

A practical agenda for the proposed MENA-Water discussion would be: official EOI; consultant independence; comparable SCADA design references; site surveys; interface specification; local permissions. The output could be a one-page responsibility and evidence matrix before either firm spends time on a bid.

Which interface or qualification would you want to resolve first?

Hi Osaid,

For Zarqa SCADA design advisory lead, I would keep the commercial discussion tied to an agreed work package, acceptance criteria and delivery capacity. There is no assumed award, fee split or partner commitment.

Would you be comfortable assessing a possible introduction with Khalaf Dannoon at MENA-Water, once the access and scope questions are resolved?

Hi Osaid,

I’ll close this proposed MENA-Water introduction for now. If a technical discussion would be useful, let me know the right owner and I can coordinate once both sides agree. If this tender is not a fit, a brief “not this one” is enough.

If you prefer no further emails, please let me know.
